indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fiscal_certificates_pkey ON public.fiscal_certificates USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX ix_fiscal_certificates_company ON public.fiscal_certificates USING btree (company_settings_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_fiscal_certificates_active_per_env ON public.fiscal_certificates USING btree (company_settings_id, environment) WHERE ((is_active = true) AND (status = 'AVAILABLE'::text))

policies.qual: ((platform_private.has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'administrador'::app_role) OR platform_private.has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'financeiro'::app_role) OR platform_private.has_role(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), 'gestor'::app_role)) AND h15_company_access(company_settings_id))

triggers.name: h15_related_integrity
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER h15_related_integrity BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.fiscal_certificates FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION h15_related_integrity('company_settings_id', 'company_fiscal_settings')

triggers.name: trg_fiscal_certificates_audit
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_fiscal_certificates_audit AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.fiscal_certificates FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION tg_fiscal_certificates_audit()

constraints.name: fiscal_certificates_company_settings_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_settings_id) REFERENCES company_fiscal_settings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
